name: og-08-alt-robust-innovation-set
title: Integrated Autonomy: The Minimum Sufficient Innovation Set Across Model Structures
question: Model Upgrade plan, Phase 9 — the capstone. og-08 found that a lineage persists as the vent's support is withdrawn only with the irreducible set {pump, importer, heredity}, but each innovation there was a term of a hand-written co-limited budget. If the same withdrawal is run inside ONE persistent world assembled from the merged phases — the Phase-1 posterior as the vent, the Butler-Volmer interface making the feed, a localization class shaping it, the Phase-3 universe inside the cell, an energy_coupling class as its power budget, a boundary class as its leakiness, a heredity class as the machinery it holds, a maintenance law pricing its upkeep, a population dividing and dying by structural rewrites, seven ledgers beside it — which of the three innovations are required for off-gradient persistence, in how many of the sampled model structures, and what fraction of the lineage's essential work and material does it then supply itself?
hypothesis: og-08's set is a hypothesis generator, not a result: in the integrated world the innovations are real processes whose benefit and cost depend on the structure around them, so the required set will not be the same under every structure. The pump (an internal store charged by the drive the cell's own substrate pool sustains) should be required wherever anything persists, because the external tap vanishes with the gradient; heredity should be required wherever the inheritance class holds more machinery attached than its de-novo control does; the importer should matter only where the membrane is tight enough for concentration to pay and the ocean background is poor enough to need it; and the ocean floor the withdrawal relaxes toward — a hypothetical — should decide whether any subset persists at all.
objective: Build the integrated world (AblationStep, GeologicalDriverStep, LineageStateProcess, ActiveImportProcess with the ActiveUptakeRule, MaintenanceDemandProcess, LineageSupplyProcess, AutonomyBudgetStep, PopulationBudgetProcess, StructuralEventLogStep; the integrated_autonomy_world composite over the energy_coupling / heredity / boundary / localization faces with a permeability anchor and a maintenance law; the vg-data package integrated_autonomy carrying the Phase-1 posterior), run every subset of {pump, importer, heredity} under a sampled structural ensemble at the nominal and a rich ocean floor with the og-adv generic control and the full set over the floor axis, grade the pre-registered gates and report the intersection of the required innovations as a lattice with the continuous autonomy value decomposed by function.
claim: In the integrated world og-08's set is not sufficient: with every innovation a real process of an earlier phase, a lineage leaving the vent into a 1 % ocean persists under no sampled structure, and into a 10 % ocean only with {pump, heredity} — the importer, a transporter concentrating organics against a fatty-acid-vesicle leak while the drive is already fed by ocean H2, costs more than it returns. What decides persistence is the storage model (thioester or Fe-redox), the inheritance class (whether its machinery outlives the cell's falling organic carbon) and the ocean's substrate background — the hypothesis og-08 generated survives as 'a pump held by heredity', and the campaign's honest endpoint is that the vent-to-ocean transition turns on one hypothetical number it cannot yet constrain: what the ocean offers.

findings.statement: With every driver withdrawn to 1 % of the vent level, none of the eight subsets of {pump, importer, heredity} persists under any of the 24 sampled structures (0 persisting runs of 192); the best full-set lineages end s02 -3.8e-20 W, s21 -1e-19 W, s14 -1e-19 W short, their machinery lost as the cell's organic carbon falls to the floor and the heredity class's precursor pools with it.

evidence.observed: full set persists under 0 of 24 structures at the nominal floor; viable structures 0

findings.explanation: The persistence rule reads the settled work and material budgets with every driver at its floor. Off-gradient the external tap is gone, the store runs on the drive the cell's own H2 / organic pool sustains, and the upkeep (the Phase-6 maintenance at full coupling, 5.1e-18 W) takes most of what the best store delivers; a lineage whose heredity class cannot hold its machinery on a tenth of the carbon loses the pump with it. Artifact: artifacts/robust_innovation_set.json (lattice, floor_map).

findings.statement: At a 10 % ocean the only subset that persists is {pump, heredity}, under 2 of 24 structures (s16 (thioester acyl phosphate store, hybrid heredity, mixed boundary at the measured anchor, constant upkeep; net 9.5e-19 W, machinery 0.93, autonomy 1); s19 (thioester acyl phosphate store, rna like heredity, single chain boundary at the extrapolated anchor, constant upkeep; net 1.2e-18 W, machinery 0.97, autonomy 0.99)); the full set persists under 0. Over the viable structures the required intersection is {pump, heredity} and the importer is required in 0 of them: in the same structures the full set runs a deficit because the importer costs more than it returns (s16: net -4.9e-19 W with the importer on, its cost 1.7e-18 W; s19: net -1.1e-18 W with the importer on, its cost 1.9e-18 W).

evidence.observed: rich-floor lattice: pump+heredity 2/24, full set 0/24; required intersection [pump, heredity], union [pump, heredity]

findings.explanation: The ActiveUptakeRule concentrates organics to 30 % of the vent level against the membrane's leak at the thermodynamic cost RT ln(c_in/c_out) per mole over a 0.5 efficiency, spending up to 30 % of the work supply; with the drive already saturated by ocean H2 (K 10 uM) the imported organics add nothing to the budget, so the importer is a pure cost under the Phase-8 extrapolated leak. Artifact: artifacts/robust_innovation_set.json (lattice_rich, discrimination_rich).

findings.statement: The storage model reproduces Phase 6 inside the world — the H+/Na+ gradient store never charges at the fatty-acid leak and polyphosphate never clears its 30 kJ/mol load, while the four stores deliver at most 0 (polyphosphate), 0 (H+/Na+ gradient), 6.6e-18 (thioester) and 5e-18 W (Fe-redox) — and the inheritance class reproduces Phase 7's budget sensitivity: settled machinery off-gradient at the rich floor is hybrid 0.77, mineral state 0.74, rna like 0.41, compositional 0.27, network 0, peptide 0; peptide and network hold none, the templated classes decay as the carbon falls, the mineral and compositional classes hold on a fraction of the budget.

evidence.observed: internal power by storage class and machinery by inheritance class over the full-set runs at the rich floor

findings.explanation: The structural axes do what the earlier phases found when their classes are composed: the autonomy question factors into "can the store run the lineage" (Phase 6) and "can the inheritance class hold the machinery on what the cell makes off-gradient" (Phase 7). Artifact: artifacts/robust_innovation_set.json (lattice_rich.by_axis).

findings.statement: Off-gradient the lineages supply essentially all of their own work, material and catalysis — the persisting ones at work 1, material 0.99, information 0.89 (total 0.99); the full-set lineages at a mean total autonomy of 0.93 against 0.71 in the vent, where the tap supplies the work (work autonomy 0.054) — and most of them still cannot pay for themselves.

evidence.observed: autonomy (work / material / information / total) of persisting and of all full-set runs at the rich floor; in-vent values

findings.explanation: The continuous autonomy value is a share (internal / total); once the tap and the pore feed are withdrawn every surviving supply is internal, so autonomy saturates while the absolute budget can still be negative. Autonomy and sufficiency are different quantities. Artifact: artifacts/robust_innovation_set.json (autonomy_rich).

findings.statement: All seven ledgers close on every one of the 485 runs (carbon 1.7e-10, N 1.4e-14, P 1.5e-14, free energy 4.4e-14, information store 1.1e-14, rewrite 4.9e-32, charge 4.7e-14, element 0); 40441 structural events were logged (22365 divisions, 724 extinctions); the og-adv generic control (every driver at its floor from t = 0, no pore concentration) persists under 0/24 structures. The vg-data package carries 32 parameters: 5 calibrated (the Phase-1 posterior), 4 inferred, 3 extrapolated, 20 hypothetical, none unsourced.

evidence.observed: ledger ok on 485/485 runs; generic persists 0/24; audit {measured: 0, calibrated: 5, inferred: 4, extrapolated: 3, hypothetical: 20}

findings.explanation: The honesty indicator; the verdict rests on the 20 hypothetical numbers.

conclusion: The integrated world does not reproduce og-08: no subset persists at the nominal ocean floor, only {pump, heredity} at a 10x richer one (2/24 structures), and the importer is a net cost — the required intersection over the viable structures is {pump, heredity}; autonomy is near 1 but insufficient; every ledger closes; the generic control is rejected.

biological_validation.basis: Every innovation is a real process of an earlier phase under its own ledger and every vent endmember is a Phase-1 posterior draw, but the off-gradient verdict turns on hypothetical numbers — the ocean substrate floor, the transporter, the drive affinities, the machinery normalisation, the heredity supply — that no measurement constrains yet.

explanatory_gain.basis: Replaces og-08's formula with mechanisms that can disagree, locates where each innovation pays, and names the quantities (the ocean floor, the membrane leakiness, the inheritance class's budget sensitivity) that decide autonomy — the hypothesis generator's output.

limitations: Every number that makes the off-gradient verdict is hypothetical and swept or declared (vg-data integrated_autonomy audit); the vent endmembers alone are calibrated (the Phase-1 posterior, six draws).
One Gillespie seed per heredity class and structure; verdicts at the margin of the persistence rule can flip with the seed.
The thermal withdrawal (the cold ocean, where fatty-acid vesicles crystallise) is deferred; the lineage keeps the vent temperature.
The heredity class's rate constants are hypothetical in inheritance_budgets, so the ratio of its clock to the world's (one lineage-time unit per 60-s tick) is a declared assumption.

The population layer carries the lineage's net budget as biomass bookkeeping; the cell's own dissolved pool has no biomass sink, so division and extinction follow the budget, not the chemistry's stock.

limitations.24 sampled structures over 648 possible: the per-level breakdowns rest on 4-12 structures each.

resolved_uncertainties.Composed as mechanisms, og-08's innovati: a pump held by heredity is what persists, the importer is a cost under a leaky membrane, and the ocean floor decides.

resolved_uncertainties: Autonomy (the share supplied internally) and sufficiency (a non-negative budget) are different quantities; the first saturates off-gradient while the second can stay negative.
remaining_uncertainties: The ocean's substrate background (dissolved H2, organics) the lineage leaves the vent into — the single number the verdict turns on.
Whether a tighter boundary class (the measured charged-solute permeability) or a cheaper heredity (the attachment thresholds) changes which innovations are required.

decisions_needed.question: og-08's {pump, importer, heredity} is to be read as a HYPOTHESIS GENERATOR (plan section 10), not a result: the integrated world reproduces it only where its own hypotheticals allow, and the set it finds required is structure-dependent. Record this framing for the campaign's endpoint statement?
decisions_needed.context: Phase-9 roadmap row, decision column. In the integrated world the innovations are processes of Phases 6, 7 and 8 with real costs; which of them are required depends on the inheritance class, the ocean floor and the membrane leakiness. The honest statement is that og-08 generated the hypothesis and Phase 9 maps where it holds.

decisions_needed.question: The ocean floor: what residual substrate background (dissolved H2, organics) does a lineage leaving the vent meet? The world withdraws every driver to a fraction of the vent level (nominal 1e-2, swept 1e-3 .. 1e-1, hypothetical); the verdict turns on it.
decisions_needed.context: feed_floor is the weakest number in vg-data integrated_autonomy. A Hadean-ocean H2 / organic background from the expert would turn the floor map into a prediction.

baseline.name: Integrated autonomy world — full set at the canonical structure, nominal floor

key_assumptions: One 0.52-pL protocell (the Phase-6 individual) carries the Phase-3 universe (generalist repertoire) and the Phase-8 exchange rules; its vent is one Phase-1 posterior draw (H2 2.3-10.8 mM, dpH 3.4, 322 K); the withdrawal is linear over 100 minutes after one hour in the vent, every driver relaxing to the ocean floor (the gradient to 0).

Pump = coupling_activity 1 on the storage class, its drive sustained by the cell's live H2 / organic pool (half-saturation 10 uM) and coupled by the machinery the heredity class holds (mean function over 0.25); importer = the ActiveUptakeRule (1e-19 mol/s per substrate at full machinery, K_m 1 uM, set-point 30 % of the vent level, at most 30 % of the work supply per tick, at the thermodynamic cost over a 0.5 efficiency); heredity = attachment by the HeredityAttachmentStep (off: og-06's non-heritable control).
Persistence (pre-registered): over the final 15 % of the run the settled work budget and material budget are non-negative and at least half the founders are alive.
The heredity class runs one lineage-time unit per 60-s world tick; its precursor pools follow a tenth of the cell's organic carbon; 5 % of the lineage's work feeds its energy store.
expert_questions: What dissolved H2 and organic background does the Hadean ocean offer a lineage leaving the vent (the floor)?
Is a transporter concentrating organics against a fatty-acid-vesicle leak a plausible first importer, or must a tighter boundary come first?
Should the heredity class's budget demand off-gradient be read as a prediction (templated heredity starves first) or as an artefact of the hypothetical attachment thresholds?
